rule: Stock video is context, not proof. Historical claims require source photos, maps, documents, or archival footage with rights-ledger rows.

providers.name: Pexels API
providers.enabled_when: API key exists; exact item URL, creator, local file, and license receipt are logged
providers.reliability: respect response headers; default 200 requests/hour and 20,000/month

providers.name: Pixabay API
providers.enabled_when: API key exists; exact item page, creator, local file, and license receipt are logged
providers.reliability: respect 100 requests/60 seconds, cache results for 24 hours, and do not systematically mass download

providers.name: Mixkit
providers.enabled_when: exact download page and the item's Free License proof are logged

providers.name: Coverr
providers.enabled_when: exact download page, attribution text, and item terms are logged
providers.reliability: record attribution conservatively because current license copy is inconsistent

providers.name: Videvo or Videezy
providers.enabled_when: item-specific license is commercial-use and derivative compatible with no editorial, watermark, or attribution blocker
providers.reliability: not part of unattended default routing

hard_blocks: stock footage used as historical proof
stock footage before source proof in the first 20 seconds
provider search URL used as an item receipt
permanent hotlink instead of a local downloaded file
